data.one_liner: Official CLI for the GetX framework to scaffold projects, files, and manage dependencies.
data.what_it_does: Provides command-line tools to quickly initialize GetX projects, generate pages, controllers, models, and internationalization files, and install packages.
use_when: You are building an app with the GetX framework and want to automate boilerplate generation.
You prefer structured project scaffolding like GetX Pattern or Clean architecture.
avoid_when: You do not use the GetX ecosystem.
You manage your project structure and file creation manually.
strengths: Accelerates project setup and boilerplate creation for GetX apps.
Built-in support for generating models from JSON and localization assets.
weaknesses: Can overwrite existing files if commands like `get init` are used carelessly.
Tied exclusively to the GetX framework philosophy.
data.setup_notes: Install globally using `dart pub global activate get_cli` or `flutter pub global activate get_cli` and add the SDK bin directory to your system PATH.
data.minimal_example:
flutter pub global activate get_cli
get create project
